name: Tepic

queries.query: Tepic Mexico official cadastral map parcel GIS Nayarit catastro predial
queries.result: Found official Tepic and Nayarit cadastral custodian/procedure sources. The reviewed public material describes digital cadastral cartography delivered by request and municipal manzana plans in PDF, but no anonymous parcel map/API with safe ID-plus-geometry response was exposed.

queries.query: Tepic Nayarit catastro mapa catastral parcelas sitio oficial
queries.result: Encontradas fuentes oficiales del Ayuntamiento de Tepic y del Gobierno de Nayarit que identifican Catastro, cartografía catastral digital y procedimientos de atención. Las páginas revisadas no publican un visor parcelario anónimo ni una API pública con identificador y geometría segura.

registryBasis: The official Nayarit cadastral service record identifies the Dirección de Trámites y Servicios Catastrales / Dirección General de Catastro y Registro Público, gives a Tepic office, and offers digital cadastral cartography by predio, manzana, or localidad after an application and payment. Tepic's official materials separately identify the municipal Dirección de Catastro e Impuesto Predial and a municipal PDF planeria viewer. This evidences local/state custodians and procedures, not an open parcel data service.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Gobierno del Estado de Nayarit, Secretaría de Administración y Finanzas, Dirección de Trámites y Servicios Catastrales
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official service record says cadastral cartography can be supplied digitally by parcel, urban block, or locality, with cadastral key/location requested at the office; it is a paid application workflow and publishes no public map/API endpoint, schema, or CRS.

Official government report says 2,084 DWG cadastral-map files were converted to PDF and 1,733 uploaded to a Visor de Planería de Catastro for municipal dependencies. It does not expose a public parcel API or machine-readable geometry service.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: XLIII Ayuntamiento de Tepic, Dirección de Catastro e Impuesto Predial
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official organization page identifies the municipal cadastral and property-tax directorate.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: H. XLIII Ayuntamiento de Tepic, Transparencia Fiscal
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official transparency index publishes cadastral-value and cadastral-services PDFs, but no public parcel layer or API.
Current page JavaScript/HTML was inspected. Its embedded public maps are traffic accident history and Waze real-time traffic, not cadastral parcels; no cadastral service configuration was present.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official digital cadastral-cartography procedure inspected. It requires an application, identification/authorization, payment, and delivery by CD/USB or office workflow; no anonymous parcel endpoint.
Official cadastral-plan/topographic service lead inspected; it describes field/cartography processing and required documents, not a public parcel service.
Municipal cadastral custodian identified. No viewer or service endpoint advertised on the reviewed page.
Current transparency listing inspected; linked files are cadastral-value/service PDFs, not parcel geometries.
Current page HTML and embedded JavaScript inspected. Iframes point to /mapa-interactivo/reporte-vial/ traffic maps; no WMS/WFS/REST/GeoJSON cadastral route, layer schema, or CRS was exposed.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.status: HTTP 200 / official PDF indexed; direct fetch too large for browser text endpoint
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Search-indexed official report text was used only for the planeria-viewer observation; it provides administrative evidence, not a parcel response.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Tepic municipal and Nayarit state cadastral custodians, procedures, and current public web pages reviewed.

geometryDecision: No GeoJSON retained. No qualifying anonymous official response containing a safe native parcel identity plus unchanged geometry was available. The exact WUP point was not used to infer absence.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel or cadastral identity if publicly exposed
remainingUncertainty: The local and state cadastral custodians and digital-cartography procedures are evidenced, but the referenced municipal PDF planeria viewer's public URL/access route, parcel-layer schema, CRS, anonymous query behavior, exact-point inclusion, and citywide machine-readable coverage remain unverified. A failed public discovery does not establish citywide absence.
nextStep: A serial reviewer should independently check whether the Tepic municipal Planería viewer or Nayarit cadastral system now exposes a public anonymous map/service endpoint, then qualify a geometry-only sample before any adapter consideration.
